title: taraxacum pomelianum
intro: Taraxacum pomelianum, commonly known as the Taiwanese dandelion, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including treating digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Taraxacum pomelianum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties, which contribute to its potential in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
